identityEvidence: The Harbor Town menu specifies Rhino Dozer/Drift Hauler/Sprint Buggy, on-foot breach charges and chase/top camera controls. The separately supplied Harbor Bend menu instead specifies ATLAS-7, Bulldozer/Wrecker/Scout and Shift boost with no on-foot charge mechanic. Their implementations, menus and level routes differ. A shared title, model and date do not establish a revision lineage.

frames.body:
MELTDOWN MILE
A BLAST CORPS–INSPIRED DEMOLITION RUN · LEVEL 1: HARBOR TOWN

A damaged reactor carrier is rolling on autopilot toward the containment dock — and it cannot stop, cannot steer. Its cracked core detonates at zero. Ram, crush and blast everything blocking the red route before it arrives. Swap rigs, grab breach charges on foot, and chain the fuel tankers.

🦏 RHINO DOZER

Siege blade. Smashes towers fast, crawls between fights.

🚚 DRIFT HAULER

Handbrake slider. Balanced muscle for the mid-route.

🏎 SPRINT BUGGY

Fragile rocket. Scout ahead, ferry charges, tap debris.
